<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OnlineShopPurchase" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-purchase">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlinePurchase" name="Online Shop Purchase" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderStarted" name="Order started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToLogin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in to account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToLogin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LoginToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Setup" name="Split setup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LoginToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToSelectItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToSetPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items to purchase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToSelectItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectItemsToReward</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose free reward">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectItemsToReward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RewardToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPayment" name="Set payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToSetPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetPaymentToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Split" name="Payment option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetPaymentToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentToPay</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentToInstallment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Pay" name="Pay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentToPay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PayToPaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Installment" name="Complete installment agreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentToInstallment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InstallmentToPaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Merge" name="Payment completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PayToPaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InstallmentToPaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMergeToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Setup" name="Setup complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RewardToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMergeToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToDeliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Deliver" name="Deliver items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToDeliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeliverExchangeToDeliveryMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeliverToDeliveryMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delivery_Merge" name="Delivery made">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeliverToDeliveryMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeliveryMergeToReturnDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Return_Decision" name="Return items for exchange?" default="Flow_NoReturn">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeliveryMergeToReturnDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToDeliverExchange</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverExchange" name="Deliver exchanged items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToDeliverExchange</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeliverExchangeToDeliveryMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PurchaseCompleted" name="Purchase completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoReturn</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToLogin" sourceRef="Start_OrderStarted" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginToSplit" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Setup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSelectItems" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Setup" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSetPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Setup" targetRef="Task_SetPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectItemsToReward" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RewardToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Setup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetPaymentToSplit" sourceRef="Task_SetPayment" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentToPay" name="Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentToInstallment" name="Installment agreement" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_Installment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PayToPaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InstallmentToPaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_Installment" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Setup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToDeliver" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Setup" targetRef="Task_Deliver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliverToDeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Task_Deliver" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryMergeToReturnDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Return_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnYes" name="Items returned" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Decision" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoReturn" name="No return" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Decision" targetRef="End_PurchaseCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToDeliverExchange" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Task_DeliverExchange"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliverExchangeToDeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Task_DeliverExchange" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
